scope: Strict-prequential K0-only mapping, shrinkage, and admission study on the exact frozen C60 strict-OOS ledger; no O/C or live/canonical mutation.

selection.mu0: P0-anchor quintile map, empirical-Bayes shrinkage k=50
selection.admission: mapped K0 expected policy net >= +50 bps
selection.gate: 2025/2026 net EV/trade >=90 bps and participation >=80% of strictly-prequential isotonic-map control

validation.causality: Each held-month map used only earlier outer-OOS predictions with policy labels resolved before held-month start. Invalid rows remained scored target-free and never trained a map or economics metric.
